questions.question: While fleeing Jerusalem, King David met Ziba, who brought food and donkeys. What did David give Ziba?

answers.text: A post as captain over the guard
The job of watching the palace

questions.question: As King David fled from his son Absalom, what did Shimei son of Gera do when he met him?

answers.text: Bowed low and asked for mercy
Warned him that Absalom was coming

questions.question: When Shimei cursed King David, what did David's officer Abishai ask permission to do to him?

answers.text: Go over and cut off his head

questions.question: When Shimei cursed him, King David said there might be a reason. What did David say it might be?

answers.text: The LORD told Shimei to curse him
Absalom paid Shimei to do it
